name: Alt: the largest Vari L that fits (80x60) on the left wall for the four screens, a Vari 48x30 job desk on the right, no guest bed
notes:
Alternative for Andrew's office brief (2026-10-25: "add consifugraiton to office using vari L desk or multiple vari straight ones (bamboo), largest htat can fit"), meeting F-62 as e does with UPLIFT. The usable floor as in a and e: furniture from y 12 off the hatched heater wall (F-33, heater-depth-assumed), nothing in front of the wardrobe below y 116 or the door below y 122 (F-31: the 36" landings, assumed-position:closet and assumed-position:door). No desk stands along the window wall, so no screen faces the glass (F-38).
Why the 80x60 and not Vari's 80x80: an 80" wing across this 106" room leaves 26" to the far wall, under a 30" walkway (F-30), and that gap is the way in from the door; the only wall that takes a wing without it is the window wall, where the screens would face the glass (F-38). The 80x60's 60" return leaves 46". Vari sells no bamboo top (vari.com's own search for "bamboo" finds nothing); every desk here is in Light Wood, its nearest finish, pale like bamboo.
desk-l Vari L-Shape Electric Standing Desk 80x60, Light Wood/Slate (25-50 1/2"): rot 270, the 80" main along the left wall (x 0-27.5, y 36-116), the 60" return at its south end (x 27.5-60, y 88.5-116), on the user's left. The personal station: three 32" screens across the main on monitor arms (the outer two angled in, about 77") and the fourth on the return; they face east and north, never the window. F-31: its south end on the wardrobe's 36" landing line (y 116); F-38: it starts 36" below the window wall, so nothing stands in front of the window · fits.
desk-1 Vari ComfortEdge 48x30, Light Wood/Slate: right wall, rot 90, x 76-106, y 12-60, the separate job station, the laptop on the ELLOVEN beside one 32" monitor, with 7" to spare (F-62); 6" from the heater face (F-33) · fits. A 72" here (as first staged) left 16.6" between its end and the L's return, the only way in.
chair-1 FLINTAN in the L's corner, x 31-59, y 56-84, facing the main; it swivels to the return. chair-2 FLINTAN at the job desk, x 46.5-74.5, y 22-50, 16" from the heater wall; the chairs sit 6" apart, so both stations work at once (F-35: 48.5" from the main's front to the job desk). To reach the job desk you pass chair-1: 17" with it pulled out, about 30" with it tucked under the main.
The way in: up the right wall's lower half, 46" between the return's end and the wall, then into the room between the return's corner (x 60, y 88.5) and the job desk's end (x 76, y 60), 32.7" (F-30).
storage-2 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4" (top): hung above the job desk on two suspension rails (F-63). lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): on the L's return. lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): on the job desk's front corner. art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): right wall above the way in, y 90-112.
lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner, left of the wardrobe's landing. plant-1 FEJKA: top-left corner, above the L's north end.
rug-1 LOHALS (rug): x 30-82, y 22-99, under both chairs. rug-2 Anji Mountain bamboo chair mat (rug): x 28-76, y 50-92, under chair-1, plastic-free in place of the KOLON.
No guest bed: the L's return takes the left wall's south end and the right wall's is the way in, as in e.
Not placed: the Vari 80x80 L and the 72x30 job desk (above); the KOLON (plastic; Andrew wants mats that aren't).
Kid safety (F-21): the job desk stands by the window and its chair rolls, so Maddie could climb to the window: fit window stops there (not in the catalog; the sill is unmeasured, F-38).
Vari's photos are on www.vari.com, which isn't an allowed photo host yet, so its desks show without photos until Andrew allows it.
Extras: the HOPPVALS blinds x2, two HUANUO dual arms, the FREIVID standing mat, the ELLOVEN, the FÖRSÄSONG cable tray under the job desk, two BESTÅ suspension rails.
Total $3,295.44, prices as of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-25 (those before today are price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door, heater-depth-assumed.
